title: Teatr Nowe Formy
desc: An identity designed to change with the theatre

blocks.title: Teatr Nowe Formy
blocks.lede: An identity designed to change with the theatre — without losing its own character.

items.label: Scope
items.value: Identity, poster system, season identity, print programmes, social

blocks.statement: The theatre was full of different worlds. The identity looked like sixteen of them.
body: Strong productions were being designed as isolated jobs, so every premiere could look completely different — and the theatre itself was disappearing behind the programme.
The challenge wasn’t to make every show look the same. It was to give very different productions a recognisable home.
The identity should behave like the theatre.
Some productions are quiet. Some are absurd. Some are visceral. Some are almost surreal. The system therefore had to flex emotionally without losing its own accent.

blocks.text: Consistency shouldn’t mean making every performance look like the same performance.

body: A flexible visual system across posters, programmes, social and season communication. Different productions can push the visual language in different directions while still belonging to the same theatre.
A brand language that finally works with the theatre’s unpredictability instead of fighting it — cohesive across a season without flattening the individuality of the work.
